title_en: Humble’s Batman Day Comics Bundle Is a Treat for Fans of the Caped Crusader, With 30 Comics for Just $20
summary_en: Humble Bundle has a Batman Day Comics Bundle that features 30 Caped Crusader comics alongside a DC Universe Infinite 30-day trial offer. Normally it all has a $487 value, but you can get everything for as low as $20 through this offer.
body_en:
Batman Day may officially be behind us, but why celebrate the Dark Knight on just one day of the year? Humble Bundle is extending out the fun with its awesome Batman Day Comics Bundle , which runs for another 15 days as of the time of this writing.
For as low as $20, you can get 30 comics in total through this bundle, plus a DC Universe Infinite 30-day trial offer, which would all normally total $487 if bought separately. That's a phenomenal offer to take advantage of, and there's some real standouts - you'll get to read the likes of The Court of Owls storyline (possibly the story for Matt Reeves' The Batman: Part 2 ?) and Batman: Hush.
Those are just the tip of the iceberg, though. Have a look at the full list of comics included below.
If you decide to chip in a bit more cash than just $20, you'll give a little extra money to publishers, Humble, and charity (of which this bundle's chosen organization is Book Industry Charitable Foundation ). However, if you give less than $20, you won't get everything listed above.
Dropping to at least $12 will get you 10 items from the bundle, while $5 will get you four from the list. If you're curious what exactly you'll get when paying these amounts, Humble Bundle's main offer page can help you out.
This bundle isn't the only offer we've found swirling around Batman, either. If you're in the mood to watch some of the films, Amazon's discounted quite a few ahead of its Prime Big Deal Days sale , though not for much longer. These have a countdown clock on them at the moment that runs out after today, September 25, so now is the time to grab your favorites while they're still on sale.
This bundle, on the other hand, lasts for another 15 days. So you still have plenty of time to stock up on these comics to read this fall.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the commerce team here at IGN.
